description: Source code for a REST API managing student records using FastAPI. Implements CRUD operations for students with JWT security and OpenAPI documentation. Defines data models, API routes, and interacts with database repositories.

classes.name: StudentCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a student with fields: name, roll_number, class_id.

classes.name: StudentUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating a student with optional fields: name, roll_number, class_id.

classes.name: StudentOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for output representation of a student with attributes: id, name, roll_number, class_id, configured to use ORM attributes.

methods.name: create_student(student: StudentCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new student, checks for duplicate roll number, and adds to database.

methods.name: list_students(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a list of all students with pagination support.

methods.name: get_student(student_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a specific student by ID.

methods.name: update_student(student_id: int, student: StudentUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing student's details, with duplicate roll number validation.

methods.name: delete_student(student_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a student by ID.
